svg.title: AI agents with defined boundaries
svg.desc: Conceptual agent organization: owner, permanent leadership, role-specific managers and temporary workers. Delegation and reporting follow the hierarchy. Branches are illustrative; boundary validation remains open.
svg.text: Delegation moves down. Results move up. Access stays scoped to the role.
Branches illustrate roles, not a fixed agent count.
Reported live: daily monitoring → weekly report
Conceptual design ≠ verified isolation. Source: ai-cxo-agents/README.md · 15 Nov 2026
